title: Claude extension outbound command
description: One line of .devcontainer/tmp/logs/claude-code-vscode-ext-outbound.jsonl, appended by the notification consumer (today the daemon's notify-app.js writeAllowOutbound) and polled by the patched Claude Code extension (outbound-action-injector.py), which replays it as a simulated click on the permission prompt. A line without `v` is today's format; `v` is 1 when present. The file is wiped at container start.

requestId.description: The queue line's tool_use_id (the extension's permission requestId).

updatedInput.description: Tool input to apply. Defaults to {} on the reader side. The writer passes the queue line's tool_input through.

updatedPermissions.description: Permission rule updates. Defaults to [] on the reader side. Always [] today.

message.description: Deny reason. Read only when behavior is deny; the reader defaults it to "denied".
